meta.title: Godzilla Minus Zero (2026) — Plot Twist with A&R Short
meta.scriptStatus: DRAFT — written by Claude because the user's production package did not reach the session. Replace narration/staging fields with the user's script and re-run `npm run audio && npm run render`.

scenes.name: Ash City
scenes.narration: Tokyo, 1949. Two years after Godzilla sank, the city still smells of ash.
scenes.factNote: 1949 setting, two years after Minus One
confirmed: Story is set in 1949, two years after Godzilla Minus One (1947)
staged: Rain, smoke columns, rebuilt shacks and the lone umbrella walker are invented staging
scenes.parallax: BG storm sky 0.1 / far burnt skyline + clock tower 0.3 / mid rebuilt wooden houses 0.6 / FG utility pole, wires, rubble 1.3
scenes.actions: Smoke columns rise from the skyline; a lone figure with an oil-paper umbrella crosses the street; ash and rain fall together

scenes.name: Sleepless Survivor
scenes.narration: Koichi Shikishima survived the war and the monster. But peace never came.
confirmed: Koichi Shikishima returns, played by Ryunosuke Kamiki
staged: Night window, lightning and his restlessness are invented staging
scenes.parallax: BG dark room + window 0.2 / mid Shikishima profile 0.8 / FG rain rivulets on glass 1.4
scenes.actions: He breathes, blinks, his jaw tightens; lightning on 'peace never came' reveals his face; hand clenches the sill

scenes.name: The Mark
scenes.narration: Noriko lived too. Yet the dark mark on her neck never faded.
scenes.factNote: Noriko returns (Minami Hamabe); neck mark from Minus One ending
confirmed: Noriko returns, played by Minami Hamabe
Godzilla Minus One ended with a dark mark spreading on Noriko's neck
staged: The mark visibly crawling and the lamp-lit shoji room are invented staging
scenes.parallax: BG shoji screen + paper lamp 0.2 / mid Noriko profile 0.8 / FG drifting dust bokeh 1.4
scenes.actions: She turns slightly, raises her hand to her neck; black veins creep outward from the mark on 'never faded'

scenes.name: Noda Returns
scenes.narration: Kenji Noda, the man who sank Godzilla once, is called back.
scenes.factNote: Hidetaka Yoshioka returns as Kenji Noda
confirmed: Kenji Noda returns, played by Hidetaka Yoshioka
Noda planned the operation that sank Godzilla in Minus One
staged: The telegram, the blackboard sketch and lamp-lit office are invented staging

camera.move: tilt up from desk to face

scenes.parallax: BG blackboard with Godzilla sketch 0.3 / mid Noda 0.8 / FG desk lamp + papers 1.3
scenes.actions: Telegram slides in; he lifts his glasses, lenses glint on 'called back'

scenes.name: What It Left Behind
scenes.narration: With biologist Kanji Murakami, he studies what the monster left behind.
scenes.factNote: Min Tanaka joins as biologist Kanji Murakami
confirmed: Min Tanaka plays biologist Kanji Murakami
staged: The glowing tissue in the jar and what they study are invented staging

camera.move: slow lateral arc + rack focus FG to BG

scenes.parallax: BG Noda silhouette + shelves 0.25 / mid Murakami leaning in 0.8 / FG specimen jar 1.3
scenes.actions: Murakami leans toward the jar; the tissue twitches on 'left behind', throwing blue light on his face

scenes.name: Sagami Bay
scenes.narration: Because deep in Sagami Bay, something is still growing.
scenes.factNote: Minus One's final shot: Godzilla flesh regenerating at sea
confirmed: Godzilla was sunk off Sagami Bay in Minus One
Minus One's final shot showed a piece of Godzilla flesh regenerating underwater
staged: How far it has regrown in Minus Zero is invented staging
scenes.parallax: BG god-rays from the surface 0.2 / mid flesh mass on the seabed 0.7 / FG marine snow 1.3
scenes.actions: The mass throbs to a heartbeat; blue veins light up; a dorsal-plate tip pushes out on 'growing'

scenes.name: Blue Light
scenes.narration: Fishermen whisper about a blue light pulsing beneath the waves.
scenes.factNote: Invented staging — not a confirmed scene
staged: The fishing boat sighting is invented staging, not a confirmed film scene
scenes.parallax: BG horizon + storm clouds 0.2 / mid fishing boat with lantern 0.9 / FG wave crests 1.4
scenes.actions: Boat rocks; two fishermen lean over the rail; blue glow pulses brighter under the hull on 'pulsing'

scenes.name: The Sea Tears Open
scenes.narration: Then the sea tears open. Godzilla has returned.
confirmed: Godzilla returns in Godzilla Minus Zero
staged: The exact emergence shot is invented staging
scenes.parallax: BG storm clouds + lightning 0.15 / mid Godzilla rising 0.6 / FG spray and breaking waves 1.5
scenes.actions: The sea bulges and splits; Godzilla's head and shoulders rise, water cascading; jaws open into a roar on 'returned'

scenes.name: Spines Ignite
scenes.narration: His spines snap upward, one by one, glowing atomic blue.
confirmed: Minus One's Godzilla charges its heat ray by raising its dorsal plates
staged: This specific shot over the city is invented staging
scenes.parallax: BG burning city 0.2 / mid dorsal plates 0.8 / FG sparks and ash 1.3
scenes.actions: Plates click up one at a time from tail to head, synced to 'one by one'; blue energy crawls between them

scenes.name: Plot Twist
scenes.narration: Plot twist: Minus One was the countdown. Zero means there is nothing left.
scenes.factNote: Channel theory about the title — not confirmed
staged: The title-countdown reading is a channel theory, not confirmed story
The atomic blast over Tokyo is invented staging
scenes.parallax: BG blue-white mushroom cloud 0.2 / mid disintegrating skyline 0.7 / FG flying debris 1.4
scenes.actions: Blue heat ray fires across the city; blast blooms; PLOT TWIST card slams in; black rain begins on 'nothing left'

scenes.name: Face the Nightmare
scenes.narration: Shikishima must face his nightmare again, with everyone he loves in its path.
scenes.factNote: Characters confirmed; this moment is invented
staged: The two facing Godzilla together in the ash is invented staging

camera.move: push-in over their shoulders + slight rise

scenes.parallax: BG Godzilla + burning city 0.25 / mid Shikishima and Noriko 0.8 / FG embers and ash 1.3
scenes.actions: Shikishima steps forward and takes Noriko's hand on 'everyone he loves'; Godzilla's head turns toward them

scenes.name: Title
scenes.narration: Godzilla Minus Zero. In theaters November 2026. Follow for more plot twists.
confirmed: Japan release November 3, 2026; US release November 6, 2026
staged: Title-card design is original to this Short (not the official logo)
scenes.parallax: BG backlit Godzilla silhouette 0.2 / mid title lockup 0.6 / FG ash 1.3
scenes.actions: Title burns in on 'Godzilla Minus Zero'; release line on 'November 2026'; A&R mark grows on 'plot twists'
